sections.tldr: TL;DR: Silver Oak University Online BBA at a glance. Newly recognised, listed in the UGC Distance Education Bureau addendum of August 2026. Private university in Gujarat. It is granted as a general programme, with no named specialisation. Duration 3 Years. The fee for the current intake is not published here yet, so request it before you apply.
sections.ugcDeb: Silver Oak University is listed in the UGC Distance Education Bureau addendum of August 2026, which grants it 6 programmes for online delivery. Bachelor of Business Administration is one of them. Recognition runs for the 2025-26, academic session beginning February, 2026 to 2030-31 (upto July-August, 2030 only). Under UGC rules, an online degree from an entitled university counts the same as a regular one for jobs, government recruitment and further study. Entitlement is granted intake by intake and programme by programme, so confirm the current position for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in rather than relying on any page, including this one.
redFlags: No fee is published on this page. Any figure quoted to you by a third party should be confirmed in writing with the university before you pay.
This is a recent entitlement. Check that it covers your intake, because UGC-DEB approves each intake separately.
Check the specific recruitment notification if you are applying for a government role, as some services set their own conditions.

faqs.question: Is Silver Oak University approved for an online BBA?
faqs.answer: Yes. Silver Oak University appears in the UGC Distance Education Bureau addendum of August 2026, which grants it Bachelor of Business Administration for online delivery. Recognition runs for the 2025-26, academic session beginning February, 2026 to 2030-31 (upto July-August, 2030 only). Verify the current position for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in.

faqs.question: What does the Silver Oak University online BBA cost?
faqs.answer: The fee for the current intake is not published on this page yet. The approval is recent, and the university has not published a fee we can verify. Request the current fee structure in writing before you apply, and treat any figure from a third party with caution.

faqs.question: What specialisations are available?
faqs.answer: The programme is granted as a general BBA with no named specialisation, so there is no separate track to choose at application.

faqs.question: Is this degree valid for government jobs?
faqs.answer: An online degree from a UGC-DEB entitled university is treated as equivalent to a conventional one for employment and government recruitment. Silver Oak University holds that entitlement for this programme under the August 2026 list. Some job notices set their own rules, so check the one you are applying to.
